v: $25 per quarter for unlimited Big Blue Bus, Culver CityBus, and LA Metro bus and rail
r: Register on UCLA's transit portal, pick up at the Central Ticket Office
n: Assessed as a student fee. Excludes summer. Probably the highest-value single item in this catalog for a full-time student.

v: $45 per quarter, unlimited Big Blue Bus and Culver CityBus
r: Buy online or at the Central Ticket Office
n: Faculty and staff pay $55. Covers an entire academic quarter.

v: Discounted per-ride Big Blue Bus fare for occasional riders
r: Loaded onto your TAP card by UCLA Transportation, online or at the CTO
n: You need stored value on the TAP card before the co-pay works. Better than BruinGO if you ride rarely.

v: One additional commuter line pass — Long Beach Transit, LADOT Commuter Express, Santa Clarita, or Antelope Valley
r: Register on the transit portal, collect at the Central Ticket Office
n: Useful if you commute in from outside the basin.

v: Free shuttle service around campus
r: Just board

v: Free vehicle day-use entry at 200+ California state parks
r: Check the physical pass out from any California public library with your library card
n: Covers one vehicle with up to nine people, or one motorcycle. Not valid at federal, local, or privately operated units. Funding is currently secured through 2026 — treat permanence as provisional.

v: Reduced admission to 13+ parks including Universal Studios, Six Flags Magic Mountain, LEGOLAND, SeaWorld, San Diego Zoo, Catalina Express
r: Buy at the CTO window west of the James West Alumni Center, or online
n: Seasonal additions appear too — Halloween Horror Nights, Knott's Scary Farm, Big Bear, Raging Waters.

v: Reduced-price tickets for AMC, Cinemark, Laemmle, Landmark, Regal and Krikorian
r: Buy at the CTO or online

v: Discounted student pricing across 15 of UCLA's 25 ticketed sports
r: Buy through the CTO

v: Discounted tickets to live performances on campus
r: Buy through CAP or the CTO

v: $20 tickets with a BruinCard
r: Show your BruinCard
n: Walking distance from campus in Westwood Village.

v: Free screenings of new, cult and classic films
r: Free entry, no ticket needed

v: Discounted tickets at the Hollywood Bowl, Walt Disney Concert Hall and other venues
r: Join the Student Insiders program with a student email

t: Hollywood Bowl Park & Ride from Westwood
v: 50% off the Park & Ride shuttle with promo code BRUINS
r: Book on the Hollywood Bowl site with code BRUINS and your UCLA email
n: Runs for select summer performances only. Departs from 11020 Kinross Ave; lot parking $6 after 4pm.

v: Free or low-cost passes to LA museums and cultural institutions
r: Reserve at lapl.discoverandgo.net with your library card, then print the pass
n: LA residents 18+ with a physical LAPL card in good standing. Zip codes 90000–93599; e-cards are not accepted. Two active reservations at a time, bookable up to three months ahead. New passes release at the start of each month.

v: Free passes to Southern California museums and cultural destinations
r: Reserve through the Discover & Go portal with your county library card and PIN
n: Adults 18+ with a full-access card. Overlaps with the LAPL program but the museum lists differ — worth checking both if you hold either card.

v: Access to John Wooden Center facilities — gyms, courts, rock wall, weight room, studios
r: Register through UCLA Recreation

v: 1,000 bonus points at signup and 12 points per $1 instead of the standard 10
r: Log into Chipotle Rewards, then verify enrollment through ID.me
n: Points-based rather than a flat percentage off. Student status generally needs re-verifying each year around the start of fall term.

v: Periodic college-exclusive offers — Rivalry Week BOGO, finals-season and game-day drops
r: Automatic once you're enrolled in Chipotle U Rewards
n: Dates move year to year. Re-check each quarter.

v: ~18 offers redeemable on campus and at partnering Westwood businesses
r: Pick up a printed sheet outside the UCLA Store at Ackerman
n: Released at the start of each quarter with a short redemption window. Confirm current dates.

v: Meal vouchers for students in need
r: Apply through ASUCLA

v: Free meal vouchers for students facing financial hardship
r: Request through the ECRT or Bruin Resource Center
n: Eligibility generally requires living off campus without a meal plan.

v: Free groceries, no eligibility requirements
r: Pick up at the Community Programs Office
n: No requirements, so take only what you need.

v: Free hot meals, food and internet access
r: Walk in — 580 Hilgard Avenue

v: Education pricing on Macs, iPads and accessories, plus discounted AppleCare+
r: In person at Ackerman Union B-Level, or online
n: Purchases can go on your BruinBill account, and eligible financial aid can be applied to tech purchases.

v: Discounted pricing on computers, tablets and accessories
r: Shop in store or at uclastore.com/tech

v: Discounted and free licensed software for UCLA affiliates
r: Sign in with your UCLA logon

v: Free access to licensed software with your UCLA logon
r: Log in with your UCLA credentials

v: Refund of the difference if you find the same textbook cheaper elsewhere
r: Bring your UCLA Store receipt and proof of the lower price
n: Same ISBN and edition, new condition only, must be in stock at the competitor.

v: Loyalty program with member-only deals and early access at the UCLA Store
r: Sign up at uclastore.com

v: 250 pages of free printing every quarter
r: Print at the GSRC, Student Activities Center B11
n: Registered graduate students only. Resets quarterly.

v: 10 free printed pages daily
r: Print at SAC Suite 106

v: Up to $291 a month for groceries
r: Check eligibility and apply through UCLA Basic Needs — the CalFresh Initiative runs office hours to help
n: Undergraduates at California public colleges became automatically exempt from the student rule in June 2026. Graduate students did not — an MBA student has to qualify through a separate exemption, such as an approved Local Program that Increases Employability. Income limits apply, and you can't hold a meal plan covering more than 10.5 meals a week. Worth an appointment before assuming you don't qualify.

v: Confidential legal counseling, fees currently waived
r: Request an appointment through the Student Legal Services portal
n: Covers landlord and tenant disputes, insurance claims, replacing lost documents, and getting access to state and federal benefits. Open to all currently registered and enrolled students. The office is waiving its usual fees — check whether that still holds when you book.

v: Discount on electricity and sewer charges for income-qualified households
r: Apply online through LADWP — no proof of income needed to enroll
n: Income limits are set each year by the LADWP Board and depend on household size, so check the current table rather than assuming a figure. LADWP may verify income after you enroll.

v: Free Microsoft 365 apps on up to five personal devices
r: Download through Anderson IT with your Anderson account
n: Windows, Mac, iOS and Android, free for the length of your program. Anderson's IT Service Desk also handles setup and troubleshooting at no charge.

v: $5.99 a month — about half price — with ad-supported Hulu included
r: Verify your enrollment through SheerID from Spotify's student page
n: Re-verify every 12 months, for up to four years total. Spotify emails a reminder about 30 days before verification lapses.

v: A directory of offers open to anyone with a student email
r: Browse by category, then verify your student status with each provider
n: Spans software, technology, shopping, entertainment and health and wellbeing. Run independently of UCLA and of us — each offer is verified by the company behind it, so read the terms before relying on one.

t: $7 Panda Plate after a Dodgers home win
v: Two-entree plate for $7, roughly $5 off
r: Order in the Panda Express app with code DODGERSWIN as a Panda Rewards member
n: Only after a home win, and only until 11:59pm the following day. One per account per day. Available across LA, Orange, Riverside and San Bernardino counties, the Central Coast and parts of the Central Valley. Expiry is set to the last day of the 2026 regular season — re-check if the Dodgers reach the postseason.

t: Free Jumbo Jack on seven strikeouts
v: Free Jumbo Jack with a large drink
r: Use code GODODGERS26 in the Jack in the Box app or in store
n: Triggers when Dodgers pitchers record seven or more strikeouts in a game. Expiry is set to the last day of the 2026 regular season — re-check if the Dodgers reach the postseason.

t: Free nuggets when the Dodgers score six
v: Free 6-piece Chicken McNuggets with a $2 purchase
r: Claim it under Rewards & Deals in the McDonald's app
n: Triggers when the Dodgers score six or more runs in a home game. Expiry is set to the last day of the 2026 regular season — re-check if the Dodgers reach the postseason.
